title: Two Sum Pattern
definition: The most famous algorithmic pattern. Given an array, find two numbers that add up to a target. Solved in O(N) time and O(N) space using a Hash Map to store `target - current_value`.
simpleExplanation: Instead of checking every possible pair of numbers, you write down what number you need to hit the target. If you see that number later, you win.

answers.question: **Basic:** Write the Brute Force O(N^2) solution for Two Sum.
**Intermediate 1:** Write the optimal O(N) Time, O(N) Space Hash Map solution.
**Intermediate 2:** What if the array is already sorted? Solve in O(N) Time, O(1) Space.
**Advanced:** Two Sum III - Data structure design. Implement `add(num)` and `find(target)`.
**Expert:** 3Sum. Find all unique triplets that sum to 0.
